inlines.v: THENCEFORTH, adverb thens'forth. [thence and forth.] From that time. If the salt hath lost its savor, it is thenceforth good for nothing. Matthew 5:13. This is also preceded by from, though not from any necessity. And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him. John 19:12.
